{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
df_dtypes = df.dtypes

# Check unique values in 'site' column
top_sites = df['site'].value_counts()

# Check unique values in 'response' column
response_values = df['responded'].value_counts()

missing_values, df_dtypes, top_sites, response_values"}
